snippet.title: Urgency, Confusion, & the Power of Spiritual Gifts
snippet.description: In this episode of the Jubilee Church Podcast, Lead Pastor Bryan Mowrey joins host Jordan Dillon to unpack the vital role of spiritual gifts in the life of every believer. Together, they explore why spiritual gifts are often misunderstood, how to discern the right and wrong ways of using them, and the urgency of stewarding the gifts God has given us. The conversation also dives into the biblical standard for practicing spiritual gifts, the boldness we need to step out in faith, and which gifts are often overlooked in today’s church. Bryan also offers practical insight on pursuing the gift of prophecy and why it matters for building up the body of Christ.
